componentAcceptance: All T41 criteria are covered. Feedback withdrawal/reset is exposed through the real Host/client settings and run history: only the learning start changes, in-flight reset is single and cancelable, and stale feedback cannot rate a replaced result. Model-originated ratings require explicit approval and are audit labels, not authentication or a way around quality floors. Paid upgrades require literal true approval and the first different configured model; false/truthy/throwing approvals cannot upgrade. A second review has its own call and preserves first-attempt usage and receipts; not-started or blocked attempts cannot erase actual spend.
productAcceptance: T41 passes at integration level. Learning withdrawal/reset is available, subjective scores do not bypass quality gates, and review calls are billed separately without losing original receipts. Formal scores are 0/20 work packages, 35/63 scenarios and M0 11/12.
implementation: No product code changed. Existing adaptive feedback settings, quality gates and attempt ledger provide the controls.
Current Host/client integration, quality and maturity suites were rerun together.
testRuns: Quality gates + attempt ledger + adaptive integration + adaptive UI + adaptive maturity UI: 42 tests / 42 pass / 0 fail.
Coverage includes reset/withdrawal, approval-based upgrades, no subjective bypass, independent review calls and first-receipt retention.
Latest complete root regression remains E133: 1980 tests / 1892 pass / 0 fail / 88 skipped; check:client OK.
limitations: No real model quality judgment or inference was used; this validates offline quality and learning controls.
